subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Context-free calculations to 15
source.subtopic: Practise number bonds up to 7 (weeks 1-2), 8 (weeks 3-4) and 9 (weeks 5-10)

show.line: Eight spots on a ladybird! Five on one side, three on the other. Five and three make eight.

rounds.prompt: Six red counters and two blue. How many altogether?
Four plus the box equals eight. What goes in the box?
rounds.praise: Four and four make eight. A double!

rounds.prompt: Seven and how many more make eight? Say the number.
Eight minus five. Tap the answer.
rounds.praise: Three! Five and three make eight.

rounds.story: Eight ladybirds on a leaf. Some fly away. Now there are five. How many flew away?
rounds.praise: Three flew away! Five and three make eight.

rounds.prompt: Does it make eight? Sort the sums.

hints: Eight fingers up. How many on each hand?
Count on from the bigger number to eight.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Five plus the box equals eight.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Five plus three equals eight.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count on from five. Six, seven, eight. Three more!

parent_line: Knows the pairs of numbers that make 8.
